remoteAccessPasswordHint: The password is required to sign in from a browser and is stored hashed on this machine.
remoteAccessEnableHint: Serve this workbench to browsers on your network.
remoteAccessSecurityHint: Browser · LAN: traffic to this browser entry uses plain HTTP. Enable it only on networks you trust.
remoteAccessExternalHint: To use this browser entry away from your LAN, provide your own VPN or tunnel (for example Tailscale, WireGuard or cloudflared).
remoteAccessMobileSecurityHint: Kun iOS · relay: uses HTTPS/WSS (TLS) with Kun account sign-in and desktop device approval. Conversation history stays on this computer; attachments may pass through temporary cloud storage. End-to-end encryption is not provided.
remoteAccessQrHint: Scan with a phone or tablet on the same network
remoteAccessPasswordRequired: Set a password first — it protects Remote on your network.
remoteAccessStopToChange: Stop Remote to change listen settings.
remoteAccessTailscaleHint: Check whether Tailscale is set up on this host to reach Kun from outside your LAN.
remoteAccessTailscaleFound: Tailscale is connected — devices on your tailnet can use this address.
remoteAccessTailscaleInstalled: Tailscale is installed but not connected. Open Tailscale and connect, then detect again.
remoteAccessTailscaleMissing: Tailscale was not detected on this host.
remoteAccessBrowserOff: Off · browsers on your network can open Kun once on

remoteCompact.offHint: Open an entry to access this computer remotely.
remoteCompact.signInRequired: Sign in to Kun with Plus membership or higher
remoteCompact.inputRequired: Input control permission required; viewing is available
remoteCompact.inputUnknown: Input permission is unknown; recheck before controlling
remoteCompact.unsupported: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 13 or later
remoteCompact.desktopReadError: Desktop state unavailable. Recheck to retry.
remoteCompact.desktopActionError: The desktop action could not be confirmed. Recheck displays and permissions.
remoteCompact.restartHint: Enable sharing and reauthorize after restarting Kun.
remoteCompact.permissionHint: Complete the password or Touch ID prompt in System Settings, then recheck here. If permission is allowed but ineffective, quit and reopen Kun.
